description: Generate a hosted, shareable sample pitch deck from a short prompt with no PitchBoost account. The deck carries a small PitchBoost badge and the response includes a single-use claim token the user can enter after signing in to move the deck into their own account. Use this when the user has not connected PitchBoost. Generation takes up to a minute.

prompt.description: What the deck should cover: the prospect or company, the offer, the audience, and the goal. Up to 1000 characters.

name: create_sample_deck
title: Create a sample deck (no account)
